located_observations.location: upper center between two reaching arms
located_observations.observation: The right neighbor holds the screwdriver handle; the left neighbor receives its metal shaft. Both hands and tool ownership are visually distinct.

located_observations.location: left foreground chair and right garment
located_observations.observation: The left free hand braces the chair back/slat rather than the loosened seat joint. The right hand pinches a torn garment edge; a threaded needle lies beside the fabric. An active stitch at the tear is not clearly depicted.

located_observations.location: central explanation and lower-right participation group
located_observations.observation: Both explanation sentences are compressed into two small centered lines. Fee, deadline, invitation and URL are legible on close reading but visibly smaller than comfortable main-body copy.
Chair and coral garment occupy substantial opposing sides and foreground. Reaching arms connect the neighbors over the table. The heavy title dominates the central reading opening.
Hangul counters and word boundaries are clear. The gouache-like brush marks are confined to imagery; copy has sharp flat dark edges. A thin vertical rule separates the adjacent information groups.

copy.observations: All twelve copy entries visually present once. Soft wrap in the long explanation; no fixed linebreak condition.

assigned_style.observations: Continuous oblique table and large working neighbors at opposite ends, coral/aubergine/light yellow-green painted palette. More modeled painterly figures than strongly simplified silhouettes.

substantive_non_glyph.observations: Tool exchange, chair support and handling torn clothing are substantive, connected repair content; no separate text column.

information_relationship.observations: English/title/statement/explanation descend through table center, then event and participation groups sit adjacent. Small body and large headline weaken the intended body emphasis.

hangul.observations: Stable widths, balanced counters and baseline, clear phrase spaces; smallest copy remains small at usage720.

function_contact.observations: Four arm/hand continuities readable. Chair bracing at back is plausible; tool exchange is clear. Actual chair tightening and stitch contact are indirect.

material_edges.observations: Painted chair wood, clothing folds and table grain are coherent, no visible halo or cropped glyphs.

basic_exclusion.observations: Substantial shared human scene, exchange and foreground chair/garment shape the field. Table opening still centers a fairly conventional large heading and small information stack; body scale merits repair.

residuals: At usage720 the explanation and participation copy are small relative to the headline; enlarge them using a smaller title and greater contiguous table opening.
Chair tightening and active stitching are indirect; a screwdriver exchange is clearly depicted.
